sequence.description: Otto Lopez reaches on a fielding error by shortstop Francisco Lindor.
Heriberto Hernández grounds out, shortstop Francisco Lindor to second baseman Marcus Semien to first baseman Jared Young. Otto Lopez to 2nd.
Liam Hicks singles on a ground ball to left fielder Tyrone Taylor. Otto Lopez scores. Liam Hicks to 2nd.
Xavier Edwards pops out to shortstop Francisco Lindor.
Leo Jiménez grounds out, first baseman Jared Young to pitcher Zac Thornton.
A.J. Ewing flies out to right fielder Javier Sanoja.
Francisco Lindor singles on a sharp line drive to right fielder Javier Sanoja.
Bo Bichette grounds into a force out, shortstop Otto Lopez to second baseman Xavier Edwards. Francisco Lindor out at 2nd. Bo Bichette to 1st.
Carson Benge singles on a sharp line drive to center fielder Esteury Ruiz. Bo Bichette to 3rd.
Jared Young grounds into a force out, fielded by shortstop Otto Lopez. Carson Benge out at 2nd.
